Cost Per Dose: 250eb (Expensive)

The much scarier successor to Deep Dive. It’s extremely addictive, and rather than just causing vague imagery, can actually lead to full personality reconstruction if utilized in the most horrific ways.

⋙ PRIMARY EFFECT ⋘

  • Lasts 1 hour.
  • The user’s Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1, which is returned if the user isn’t affected by Phant’s Secondary Effect.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, the user enters an extremely warped perception of reality, and their memory is very hazy if not impossible to fully recollect. During this time, anyone that makes a successful opposed Persuasion Check against the user can roll on or choose an option from the “Your Personality” and “How Do You Feel About Most People” Lifepath Tables (CP:R, pg. 48). These choices are how the user must act for the remaining duration of the Primary Effect, and they believe this is how they’ve always acted, even if this is in direct opposition to their usual personality or causes conflict with those they usually consider to be allies.

⋙ SECONDARY EFFECT (DV19) ⋘

  • The user takes 1d6 Humanity Loss.
  • If the user wasn’t addicted to Phant already, they are now. While addicted, they suffer a permanent -2 penalty to all Acting, Concentration, Conversation, Deduction, Human Perception, and Persuasion Skill Checks.

Cost: 250eb (Expensive) per dose
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • While addicted, switch on the "Phant Addiction" effect.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; caps, minimums, durations, and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).
